diagnostics.adapter_generation: Every attempt uses its originally frozen v3 bundle; later arithmetic and documentation-discovery changes do not alter generation inputs.
diagnostics.document_key_coverage: Core freshness/scope conclusions are supported. Deterministic IDs and endpoint error classification demanded by the frozen key are omitted; preserve partial coverage and unresolved full-key outcomes.
diagnostics.frozen_phase_key: Requires legacy-hash compatibility unrelated to the fresh-preflight scenario. All phase answers omit it; full-key outcomes remain unknown. Public key correction applies only to future runs.
diagnostics.graph_navigation_key: The frozen callees key ambiguously mentions graph execution. Its public successor explicitly permits graph navigation while preserving uncertainty about scenario behavior, tests and installed-binary conformance. This run retains its original key.
diagnostics.reference_key_coverage: The final source-only answer correctly traces dependencies and removal limits, but does not establish caller total/count/truncation metadata. Its full-key outcome stays unknown; explicit unreferenced fields do not establish caller coverage.
diagnostics.skill_reference: Neutral-arm commentary mentions an unavailable local skill. No source tool call reading a skill file was observed in that attempt; the origin of the mention is unknown. Do not infer proven host isolation or proven skill injection.

limitations: Four public curated source projections; no held-out tasks or representative repository discovery.
Repetitions are not independent task samples. Provider caching and serving variability are uncontrolled.
Host load was uncontrolled; local fixture tests and validation ran during part of the model campaign. Wall-clock differences need a controlled rerun for qualification.
Requested model is pinned; actual served model and billing/quota cost are not reported.
Host isolation and installed native binary correspondence to the dirty source tree are not proven.
Review declarations are source-backed maintenance judgments, not independent semantic evaluation.
Outcome intervals describe unresolved review judgments; they are not statistical confidence intervals.
Native prompt refinement, personal profile and accepted coding-task benefit are not measured.
The bounded archive differs in key, adapter and budget. Do not infer a causal budget-only effect by pooling runs.
